title: Heart of Christmas Celebration
seo_title: Heart of Christmas Celebration at Big Cedar Lodge
description: Heart of Christmas Celebration is a holiday event where families and friends gather for a reimagined Christmas tradition with a heartwarming holiday story, live performances, and festive characters. It takes place Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 5:00 PM to 5:30 PM at Big Cedar Lodge, 190 Top of the Rock Rd in Ridgedale, Missouri.
address: 190 Top of the Rock rd, Ridgedale, MO, 65739
